prompt: RimWorld plant sprite, painterly: the ultriss pad. A broad, flat pad of pale green flesh that keeps almost all of itself under the sand, presenting only a thin rind flush with the ground to take the raking light. It holds the open ground by tolerance rather than strength, ringing every shaded patch just beyond the reach of the thornier things that would otherwise crowd it out, and thinning into the bare pavement past that.
